method: candidate lines proposed by corridor detection; identity decided from printed address runs and street-name labels
why_not_one_block_off: Sheet 58 spans 27th-30th St, sheet 65 spans 30th-33rd, so 30th is the only shared street; both plates print '30TH ST.' in this band (sheet 65 with '59' above it, sheet 58 with '64' below it). The avenue-frontage runs change hundred-block exactly across it: the block north of the corridor (sheet 58) carries 2922/2924/2926/2928 down its Ave O 1/2 face - the 29th-30th segment - while the block south of it (sheet 65) carries 3001/3003/3005 down the same avenue face, the 30th-31st segment; sheet 65's next street south (31st) is where 30xx would become 31xx. The street-frontage numbers also place the seam in x: sheet 58's frontage on this street reads 1702/1704/1706/1708/1710/1712 then 1714/1716/1718/1720/1722/1724, ending at the block corner; sheet 65's reads 1801/1803/1805/1807/1809, the run starting one avenue east - the 17xx->18xx change is Avenue O 1/2, the single line these two sheets share. '80'' is printed mid-street on both plates (sheet 58 at native (2993,3660), sheet 65 at native (297,227)); '70'' is printed in Ave O 1/2 on both.
note: Detection candidates (58: 3224/2072/920; 65: 668/1821/2975) are mid-block lines. These two sheets meet only at the 30th St / Ave O 1/2 corner, so both readings were taken there. Sheet 58: north face 3548, south face 3780 at native x 2750-3015 (width 232), centre 3664 - note sheet 58's blocks step ~120 px in y between its middle and east columns, so this corridor y is valid only at the shared east corner.
